name: firehose
description: Amazon Data Firehose  Amazon Data Firehose was previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.

subcommands.name: create-delivery-stream
subcommands.description: Creates a Firehose stream. By default, you can create up to 50 Firehose streams per Amazon Web Services Region.

options.name: --delivery-stream-name
options.description: The name of the Firehose stream. This name must be unique per Amazon Web Services account in the same Amazon Web Services Region.

options.name: --delivery-stream-type
options.description: The Firehose stream type. This parameter can be one of the following values:    DirectPut: Provider applications access the Firehose stream directly.

options.name: --kinesis-stream-source-configuration
options.description: When a Kinesis data stream is used as the source for the Firehose stream, a KinesisStreamSourceConfiguration containing the Kinesis data stream Amazon Resource…

options.description: Used to specify the type and Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key needed for Server-Side Encryption (SSE)

options.name: --s3-destination-configuration
options.description: [Deprecated] The destination in Amazon S3. You can specify only one destination

options.name: --extended-s3-destination-configuration
options.description: The destination in Amazon S3. You can specify only one destination

options.name: --redshift-destination-configuration
options.description: The destination in Amazon Redshift. You can specify only one destination

options.name: --elasticsearch-destination-configuration
options.description: The destination in Amazon ES. You can specify only one destination

options.name: --amazonopensearchservice-destination-configuration
options.description: The destination in Amazon OpenSearch Service. You can specify only one destination

options.name: --splunk-destination-configuration
options.description: The destination in Splunk. You can specify only one destination

options.name: --http-endpoint-destination-configuration
options.description: Enables configuring Kinesis Firehose to deliver data to any HTTP endpoint destination. You can specify only one destination

options.name: --tags
options.description: A set of tags to assign to the Firehose stream. A tag is a key-value pair that you can define and assign to Amazon Web Services resources. Tags are metadata.

options.name: --amazon-open-search-serverless-destination-configuration
options.description: The destination in the Serverless offering for Amazon OpenSearch Service. You can specify only one destination
